title: 晶圓缺陷分類與良率分析
titleEn: Wafer defect classification and yield analysis
summary: 從缺陷單位、混淆矩陣到改善驗證：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Defect units and Confusion matrix to Improvement verification: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 缺陷單位 → 檢出門檻
stages.description: 把「缺陷單位」「座標配準」「檢出門檻」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Defect units, Coordinate registration, Detection threshold.

steps.title: 缺陷單位：建立模型
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「多次檢出不一定代表多個實體缺陷」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Multiple detections need not mean multiple physical defects.
steps.instruction: 分開影像缺陷、實體缺陷與失效晶粒三種計數。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Separate image detections, physical defects and failed dies. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 多次檢出不一定代表多個實體缺陷；同一缺陷可能在多層被重複觀察。
steps.observationEn: Multiple detections need not mean multiple physical defects; One defect may appear on several layers.
steps.failure: 若採用「把檢出事件數直接當失效晶粒數」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Equating detection count with failed-die count", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 提交「缺陷單位」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：多次檢出不一定代表多個實體缺陷。
steps.checkEn: Submit the Defect units diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Multiple detections need not mean multiple physical defects.

knowledge.title: 缺陷單位／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 機制：多次檢出不一定代表多個實體缺陷。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanism: Multiple detections need not mean multiple physical defects.

knowledge.title: 缺陷單位／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 模型邊界：不可由目前成果直接推出「把檢出事件數直接當失效晶粒數」。
knowledge.textEn: Model boundary: the current result does not establish the following claim: Equating detection count with failed-die count.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜接班建模：先寫出不能推論的事
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Shift intake: state what the evidence cannot prove
knowledge.text:
以「晶圓缺陷分類與良率分析」為本次任務邊界，閱讀「缺陷單位：建立模型」後，先列出輸入、輸出與量測單位。特別檢查：檢測到的缺陷數不是致命缺陷密度或電性良率。將已知、模型假設與未量測項目分開，再進入「良率戰情室：量測、SPC 與交班」整合遊戲。

需留下的證據：任務邊界表：晶圓缺陷分類與良率分析 的資料版本、單位、輸入／輸出及一項不能由現有證據支持的結論。

驗證與交接：能用自己的話解釋為何「檢測到的缺陷數不是致命缺陷密度或電性良率」，且沒有把猜測寫成實測。
knowledge.textEn:
Use Wafer defect classification and yield analysis as the task boundary. After reading “Defect units: construct and analyze”, list inputs, outputs and measurement units. Check specifically: Detected defect count is not fatal-defect density or electrical yield. Separate known data, model assumptions and unmeasured items before entering “Yield room: metrology, SPC and handoff”.

Evidence to retain: Boundary sheet for Wafer defect classification and yield analysis: data version, units, inputs/outputs and one unsupported conclusion.

Verification and handover: Explain why “Detected defect count is not fatal-defect density or electrical yield” and do not present assumptions as measurements.

quiz.question: 關於「缺陷單位」，哪項推論有物理依據？
quiz.questionEn: For Defect units, which inference has a physical basis?
options: 多次檢出不一定代表多個實體缺陷
把檢出事件數直接當失效晶粒數
直接疊圖而不檢查鏡像
optionsEn: Multiple detections need not mean multiple physical defects
Equating detection count with failed-die count
quiz.explanation: 多次檢出不一定代表多個實體缺陷；錯誤主張的問題是未保留必要條件或機制。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiple detections need not mean multiple physical defects. The competing claim omits a necessary condition or mechanism.

steps.title: 缺陷單位：故障判讀與驗證
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把檢出事件數直接當失效晶粒數」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Equating detection count with failed-die count.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「缺陷單位」成果，先指出錯誤主張「把檢出事件數直接當失效晶粒數」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：同一缺陷可能在多層被重複觀察。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Defect units artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Equating detection count with failed-die count". Introduce this diagnostic principle: One defect may appear on several layers. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 多次檢出不一定代表多個實體缺陷；同一缺陷可能在多層被重複觀察。
steps.observationEn: Multiple detections need not mean multiple physical defects; One defect may appear on several layers.
steps.failure: 若採用「把檢出事件數直接當失效晶粒數」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Equating detection count with failed-die count", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check: 交出「缺陷單位」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「同一缺陷可能在多層被重複觀察」如何改變前一步的判讀。
steps.checkEn: Submit a normal/fault comparison for Defect units, its observable and one remaining uncertainty. Explain how "One defect may appear on several layers" changes interpretation of the preceding artifact.

knowledge.title: 缺陷單位／物理與模型
knowledge.text: 診斷機制：同一缺陷可能在多層被重複觀察。
knowledge.textEn: Diagnostic mechanism: One defect may appear on several layers.

knowledge.title: 缺陷單位／驗證與限制
knowledge.text: 可證偽性：「把檢出事件數直接當失效晶粒數」與「多次檢出不一定代表多個實體缺陷」不可混為同一推論；對照需能觀察兩者的差別。
knowledge.textEn: Falsifiability: "Equating detection count with failed-die count" is not equivalent to "Multiple detections need not mean multiple physical defects"; the control must expose their difference.

steps.title: 座標配準：建立模型

steps.instruction: 用晶圓缺口和三個不對稱標记對齊兩站地圖。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。
steps.instructionEn: Register two maps with a notch and asymmetric marks. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.
steps.observation: 翻面及旋轉會改變座標對應；鏡像配準錯誤會破壞因果追蹤。
steps.observationEn: Flips and rotations change coordinate correspondence; Mirror errors break causal tracing.
steps.failure: 若採用「直接疊圖而不檢查鏡像」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
